# Creating VMs by importing images from web pages {#virt-creating-vms-from-web-images}

You can create virtual machines (VMs) by importing operating system images from web pages.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> You must install the QEMU guest agent on VMs created from operating system images that are not provided by Red Hat.

## Additional resources {#additional-resources_virt-creating-vms-from-web-images}
